title: Chaalbaaz
desc: Separated twins Anju and Manju grow up differently and accidentally swap lives. Shy Anju enters a rustic world, while bold Manju bravely takes revenge on their evil uncle.

title: Haq
desc: In 1980s India, Shazia Bano fights for child support, but her husband's attempt to silence her through triple talaq sparks a nationwide debate on women's rights.

title: Taal
desc: Mansi rises to fame with Vikrant's help after being insulted. But when her ex apologises and wants her back, she must choose between past pain and present success.

title: Hero No. 1
desc: A rich businessman hides his identity and pretends to be Raju, happily doing household chores. His skills and charm help him win over his girlfriend's family, all for love.

title: Love, Sex Aur Dhokha 2
desc: Three interconnected tales follow different people navigating the murky waters of human intimacy, sexual discovery, personal identity, and modern romance inside a hyper-connected, digital world.

title: Kisi Ka Bhai Kisi Ki Jaan
desc: Bhaijaan, the eldest brother, stays unmarried to keep peace in the family. But things get complicated when his younger brothers secretly try to make him fall in love.

title: Aa Ab Laut Chalen
desc: Rohan Khanna moves to the US for work and finds himself torn between Pooja and Loveleen. Eventually, he realises his heart belongs to Pooja and returns to her.

title: Pure Bollywood
desc: Bollywood songs - catchy, emotional, and upbeat - dominate the charts. From heartbreak to celebration, these tracks capture every mood, making people dance, cry, and sing along everywhere.

title: The Bhootnii
desc: Heartbroken Shantanu seeks true love under the Virgin Tree, but things spiral when Mohabbat, a lovestruck ghost, begins obsessing over him and turns his life upside down.

title: Naseeb Apna Apna
desc: A controlling father forces his son into marrying a simple rural bride, who moves to the city only to discover her new husband secretly shares another home with someone else.

title: Satyaprem Ki Katha
desc: Sattu, a failed lawyer, dreams of marrying Katha, a girl out of his league. Fate unites them, and Sattu tries to win her love with sincerity.

title: Doodh Ka Karz
desc: Falsely accused of theft, a snake charmer is beaten to death by landlords. His wife, Parvati, raises their son Suraj, who sets out with his loyal snake to avenge his father's murder.

title: Chitchor
desc: Geeta's father mistakenly brings home the wrong groom. As love unexpectedly blossoms, a letter arrives that changes everything for the newly formed couple.

title: Tezaab
desc: After his parents' murder, Mahesh is imprisoned and separated from Mohini, who suffers under her cruel father. Years later, he returns to rescue her and avenge his past.

title: Phool Aur Kante
desc: Ajay, the son of a crime boss, lives peacefully until rivals kidnap his father. Forced into the underworld, he must confront danger and fight to save his family.

title: Iqbal
desc: Iqbal, a hearing- and speech-impaired boy, dreams of playing for India. When his condition blocks his selection, he turns to a retired coach to train him for his dream.
